title: Commercial Property Paralegal
description:
Commercial Property Paralegal Warwickshire Salary DOE

A quality role, a supportive team and the opportunity to take real ownership of your work.

I'm working with a leading law firm looking to bring an experienced Commercial Property Paralegal into its team in Warwickshire.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys commercial property work and wants to be part of a firm that gets the balance right: high-quality work, genuine autonomy and a working environment where people feel supported and valued.

You'll have the opportunity to play an important role in the team, take ownership of your workload and work on a varied range of commercial property matters, with the support of experienced colleagues around you.

Importantly, this is a role where the emphasis is on doing good work in the right environment. If you're looking to move away from an overly pressured or volume-driven set-up and into a team that values quality, collaboration and a manageable workload, this could be well worth exploring.

What makes this opportunity stand out?
- Quality of work: Exposure to a varied caseload of commercial property matters, giving you the opportunity to build on your existing experience.
- Autonomy and ownership: The chance to take responsibility for your work, play an active role in transactions and make a genuine contribution to the team.
- A supportive culture: Work alongside approachable, experienced colleagues who value teamwork and provide support when you need it.
- A manageable workload: A more balanced approach, allowing you to focus on delivering quality work without the expectation of simply processing volume.
- Long-term development: An opportunity to continue building your commercial property expertise within a leading firm that offers a positive environment to grow.

Who would suit this role?

I'm keen to speak with experienced Commercial Property Paralegals who have a solid grounding in commercial property transactions, take pride in their work and are looking for a role where they can develop their expertise while enjoying the environment they work in.

You might already be happy in your current position but feel ready for a change of environment, or perhaps you're looking for greater responsibility and a team that offers the right level of support.

Either way, if quality of work, culture and work-life balance are important to you, this is an opportunity worth a conversation.

Location: Warwickshire

Salary: Dependent on experience

If you'd like to hear more, get in touch for a confidential discussion. I'd be happy to talk you through the opportunity and give you a better feel for the team and what the role could offer.

At Gleeson Recruitment Group, we embrace inclusivity and welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We are proud to be a disability confident employer.

By applying you will be registered as a candidate with Gleeson Recruitment Limited. Our Privacy Policy is available on our website and explains how we will use your data.

title: Commercial Property Paralegal
company: The Eventus Recruitment Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
Eventus Legal are seeking a Commercial Property Paralegal for a full-time, permanent job with a specialist, employee-owned property law firm in Warwick, Warwickshire. The salary is £27,000, with office-based working throughout, flexible start times, private medical cover and a discretionary profit-share bonus. This Commercial Property Paralegal opportunity would suit an ambitious Law graduate who has achieved a 2:1 degree or above, has strong A-level results and has completed the LPC or is undertaking the SQE. The successful candidate must have a genuine interest in transactional Commercial Property law and be keen to develop a long-term career within this specialist area.

Role Responsibilities

This Commercial Property Paralegal will contribute to a busy team delivering specialist transactional property advice. Key responsibilities will include:
- Assist qualified solicitors and partners with commercial property transactions under close supervision
- Support work involving commercial leases, acquisitions, disposals and property development matters
- Help prepare, review and organise transaction documents and maintain accurate matter files
- Liaise with supervising fee earners and colleagues to progress work and meet deadlines
- Develop technical knowledge through practical file work, training sessions and regular feedback

Joining a supportive and collaborative team, you will benefit from hands-on experience working closely with experienced solicitors and partners, alongside structured training and ongoing professional development. The firm has a strong track record of developing Paralegals into qualified Solicitors, with the opportunity to be considered for a training contract or other formal qualification pathway after a minimum of six months. Whilst progression to formal training is not guaranteed, the firm is committed to supporting individuals who demonstrate the ability, dedication and ambition to develop their careers long term.

Person Specification

The firm is looking for someone who combines relevant ability with a genuine commitment to its collaborative approach. Applicants should be able to demonstrate:
- A 2:1 or above in Law or a degree with a law conversion qualification
- Strong A-level results and a sound academic record
- A genuine interest in transactional commercial property law and a long-term career in this field
- Careful attention to detail, clear communication and a collaborative approach
- SQE or LPC study/completion is essential; prior legal experience is a bonus

Benefits and Rewards

The firm offers a package designed to support wellbeing and long-term professional development. Benefits and working arrangements include:
- Office-based working, with close day-to-day access to supervising lawyers and the early-talent team
- Discretionary profit-share bonus
- Up to 30 days of annual leave plus bank holidays
- Private medical cover
- Enhanced pension contributions
- Flexible start between 8.00am and 9.30am, with corresponding finish time
- Structured support, mentoring and ongoing professional development
- The chance to be considered for a training contract or other qualification route after six months

About the Law Firm

Our client is a specialist, employee-owned commercial property law firm with a collaborative approach to transactional work and a strong focus on developing its people. Its team advises clients across property transactions, and its B Corp certification reflects a wider commitment to responsible business. The firm is based in a countryside setting with convenient access to Warwick and the M40.

Next Steps

Apply now to be considered for this career-enhancing job opportunity. Alternatively, for a confidential discussion about this Commercial Property Paralegal job in Warwick, Warwickshire, please send your CV to Gemma Clarke at the Eventus Recruitment Group for a confidential discussion. Due to the high volume of applications, if you have not heard from us within ten days, unfortunately you have not been shortlisted on this occasion.

If this job isn't quite right for you but you are looking for a new position, please contact me at the details above for a confidential discussion on your career.

The Eventus Recruitment Group are award-winning recruitment specialists operating in the Legal, Finance and Financial Planning sectors across the UK. Please note, the years' experience and/or salary are listed in our advertisements as a guide. We are happy to consider applications from all candidates who are able to demonstrate the skills necessary to fulfil the role. As an equal opportunities employer we welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and circumstances. Our privacy policy can be found on the bottom of our website.

title: Conveyancing Legal Assistant
description:
Conveyancing Legal Assistant - Leamington Spa

A well-established and reputable law firm is looking for an experienced Conveyancing Legal Assistant to join its friendly and supportive team in Leamington Spa.

Working alongside senior fee earners, you will provide support across a busy residential conveyancing caseload, assisting with matters from instruction through to completion. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with strong conveyancing knowledge who is confident working independently and delivering excellent client service.

- Strong knowledge of residential conveyancing
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail
- Confident managing your own workload with minimal supervision
- Strong communication and client care skills
- A proactive and collaborative approach

Benefits
- Additional Christmas/New Year leave
- Birthday day off
- Long-service holiday benefits
- Practising Certificate funding
- Workplace pension
- Death in service scheme
- SimplyHealth cash plan
- Wellbeing support, including GP and counselling services
- Annual office day out

If you're an experienced Conveyancing Legal Assistant looking for a new opportunity with a supportive and established firm in Leamington Spa, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
An excellent opportunity has arisen for a Conveyancing Paralegal to join a well-established and highly regarded residential property team based in Leamington Spa. This is a fantastic role for a motivated individual looking to build a long-term career within a busy, supportive and high-performing law firm known for its strong local reputation and consistent workflow.

This role offers exposure to a broad range of residential conveyancing matters, working alongside experienced solicitors and fee earners in a collaborative environment where progression is actively encouraged.

Key Responsibilities:
- Supporting fee earners with a full caseload of residential conveyancing transactions
- Handling sales, purchases, remortgages, transfer of equity and new build matters
- Managing files from instruction through to completion with appropriate supervision
- Drafting contracts, raising enquiries and dealing with replies
- Carrying out searches, land registry applications and SDLT submissions
- Liaising with clients, estate agents, lenders and third parties to ensure smooth transactions
- Providing a high level of client care and regular updates

Key Requirements:
- Previous experience working as a Conveyancing Paralegal or Legal Assistant
- Strong understanding of the residential conveyancing process
- Ability to manage a busy workload and prioritise effectively
- Excellent communication and organisational skills
- A proactive and professional approach with strong attention to detail
- A genuine interest in developing a long-term career in property law

What's on Offer:
- Competitive salary aligned with the Leamington Spa market
- Opportunity to gain hands-on experience with high-quality residential property work
- Clear progression routes within a growing and supportive firm
- Modern working environment with strong team culture
- Ongoing training and development opportunities

This is an ideal opportunity for a driven Conveyancing Paralegal looking to join a respected firm where you can develop your technical skills and progress your legal career within a thriving property department.

title: Conveyancing Paralegal
company: Talentwise Solutions Legal Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Residential Conveyancing Paralegal

Location: Coventry, with free onsite parking

Salary: £27,500 to £32,000 commensurate with experience and qualifications

Bonus Scheme: The firm operate a performance-related bonus scheme, with top billers earning up to £3k per month.

About the firm

This is a well-established, independent law firm based in Coventry, with an excellent reputation, consistently good client reviews, a loyal client following and close ties to the local community.

The firm provide a supportive, close-knit working environment where employees have exposure to a broad range of conveyancing work ensuring genuine career progression at your own pace. With a performance-related bonus scheme in place, there is a great scope to earn a high income, significantly increasing your annual salary in recognition of your hard work.

About the Conveyancing Team

There are around 15 people in the conveyancing team, handling a high volume and wide variety of residential property matters. The firm maintain a supportive working environment where members of the team are encouraged to ask questions, learn from more experienced colleagues and develop their own careers, rather than being restricted to one part of the conveyancing process.

What you'll be doing:

Your level of responsibility will be commensurate with your knowledge and experience and will include all or some of the following duties:
- Working closely with experienced members of the conveyancing department, gaining practical exposure to a broad range of residential conveyancing work
- Developing your own conveyancing ability, managing and progressing files under supervision
- Working at your own pace to become increasingly independent
- Liaising directly with clients, estate agents, solicitors, lenders and other parties
- Reviewing title documentation and property searches
- Raising and responding to conveyancing enquiries
- Preparing matters for exchange and completion
- Dealing with freehold and leasehold transactions
- Assisting with transfers of equity, remortgages and other residential property matters
- Preparing correspondence, reports and relevant conveyancing documentation
- Ensuring clients are kept regularly updated throughout their transactions.
- Taking on increasing responsibility as your knowledge and confidence grows, whilst always having appropriate supervision available

Who we're looking for:

Suitable candidates will have:
- A good grounding in residential conveyancing (12 months'+ experience)
- A strong work ethic
- A willingness to learn and develop
- The ability to work well as part of a team
- Excellent communication skills
- A desire to progress your career within residential conveyancing

What's on offer:

The role offers a fabulous opportunity to gain hands on experience, develop your own caseload under supervision with a view to progressing into a more senior fee earning role within the firm over time.

Benefits Include:
- 20 days annual leave plus 8 bank holidays
- Additional paid leave over the Christmas shut down period (between Christmas and New Year) which does not have to be retained from your own entitlement
- Additional paid leave twice per year for Eid Celebrations which does not have to be retained from your own entitlement
- Performance related bonus scheme
- Free on-site parking, subject to availability
- Ongoing training and professional development
- Support for longer-term career progression and professional qualifications (SQE, CILEx and CLC routes are supported)
- A supportive and collaborative working environment

This is a full-time permanent job, working 9:00am to 5:30pm Monday to Friday (37.5 hours per week) The role is fully office-based.

Note: Salary stated is given as a guideline in line with market rate and will be wholly commensurate with experience. The information provided above is correct to the best of our knowledge.
